name: Transel
description: Transel was an obscure, backwater terrestrial planet located in the Transel system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Shipwrights' Trace, which connected it to the Bassadro, Fondor, and Surric systems.
lead_paragraphs: Transel was an obscure, backwater terrestrial planet located in the Transel system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Shipwrights' Trace, which connected it to the Bassadro, Fondor, and Surric systems.

A small starship engineering company was based on Transel. At a single manufacturing plant, the firm, which at one point was acquired by the larger Core Galaxy Systems corporation, for many years produced the Dynamic-class freighter, which had been designed by 4000 BBY. By 3956 BBY, Transel was a member of the Galactic Republic.
